key_insight: PaddleMaterials unifies six materials-learning task classes with verifiable cross-task interfaces and optional compiled execution.
engineering_relevance: Engineers can connect materials design, simulation and characterization models while preserving physical quantities, units and reference conventions.
method: Standardize data processing, training, evaluation and pretrained-model management across six task classes.
Record scientific semantics in task interfaces to verify cross-task composition.
Enable graph optimization, operator fusion and hardware-targeted compilation without changing model definitions.
evidence_signal: Across 65 model instances in 11 groups, compilation accelerated every instance in eight groups; LiMnO2 formation-energy predictions differed from same-geometry PBE+U references by at most 7 meV/atom, with model-step costs below one-twentieth of a DFT single-point calculation.
watch_item: Compilation did not accelerate every instance across all groups, and the case studies do not establish accuracy across broader materials and chemistries.
paper_title: PaddleMaterials: An End-to-End Deep Learning Toolkit for Materials Science
